item: row 329: a restore never follows a volume swapped for a link after its check
summary: decrypt_stream and decrypt_file take follow_links and expect_sha256, stream_key_opens takes follow_links; the stream restore, its verify and the oo-volumes-1 reassembly open backup-folder volumes without following a link and hash the bytes they decrypt, which must be the manifest's, so a volume swapped, parity-rebuilt or rewritten since the checksum pass is refused whatever its inode (no false refusal on FAT or network drives); the wrong-key probe takes its key check and checksum from one read (stream_key_opens_or_digest), so the right passphrase never reads as wrong; a refusal fails closed and never reads as a wrong passphrase; the app's own sealed files keep following links.
